what: the microphones the page holds, read through this lens -- perception never reads raw

normals.speech_rule: rms >= 10x the 20th-percentile floor of a ~5.5s rolling ring; floor frozen while a segment is open
normals.deaf_line: flat silence >20s turns the device line red; >60s stops motion-only accrual

failure_signatures.signature: worklet floor ~7e-10; saved WAVs peak 0 across every consumer (worklet, WAV, WebM audio)
failure_signatures.detector: measured peak at save time -> SILENT_AUDIO outbox alert; audio-health probe patrols the archive

verified.note: stamped by the normals-verify probe when it plays a known stimulus and measures the return
